excerpts: SAHIE variables.json: 39 variables. Dimensions: AGECAT (7: under 65, 18-64, 40-64, 50-64, under 19, 21-64, 21-29), IPRCAT (6: all, <=200%, <=250%, <=138%, <=400%, 138-400% poverty), RACECAT, SEXCAT, YEAR enum 2006..2024, GEOCAT summary level. Identifiers: GEOID (State+County FIPS), STATE, COUNTY, STABREV, NAME, US national flag. Estimates: NIPR_PT (denominator), NIC_PT (insured), NUI_PT (uninsured), PCTIC_PT/PCTUI_PT (percents) each with _MOE/_LB90/_UB90 uncertainty. Predicates: for/in (FIPS), time (datetime year, required).
